title: The Pot on Top
lines: Mom sat a pot on top.
A tot is at the pot!
Pop! The pot is not on top.
Mop it, Tom. Mop it, Mom.
The tot is in a nap.

questions.listenFor: The tot taps it and it falls. Lines two and three tell it together.
Tom and Mom, both. The fourth line names them.

questions.ask: What would you have said to the tot? Tell me.
questions.listenFor: Any kind answer. You are listening for something gentle rather than cross.
